## 2. Core Technical Competencies & Specialisations

### System Design & Distributed Systems
- Distributed microservices architecture, domain-driven design (DDD), and event-driven patterns using Redis Pub/Sub, NATS, and message queues.
- High-availability database modeling (PostgreSQL query tuning, index optimization, connection pooling, read replicas, TimescaleDB time-series data).
- Rate-limiting algorithms (Token Bucket, Sliding Window Log), circuit breakers, dynamic request throttling, and idempotency key management.
- Zero-downtime deployment pipelines, blue/green deployments, canary releases.

### Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure
- **AWS Suite**: EC2, S3, RDS, ECS (Fargate), AWS Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Route53, KMS, IAM fine-grained security policies.
- **Containerisation & Orchestration**: Docker multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, Kubernetes cluster setup, Helm charts.
- **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**: Terraform modular infrastructure blueprints.
- **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI automated testing, linting, security scanning, and production deployment pipelines.

### Backend Development & API Engineering
- **Go (Golang)**: Standard library, Gin, Fiber, Chi, gRPC, Protobuf, concurrent goroutine worker pools, channel-based processing.
- **Python / Django / FastAPI**: Django REST Framework (DRF), Celery async task workers, SQLAlchemy, FastAPI async endpoints.
- **Node.js / TypeScript**: Express, NestJS, serverless edge functions.

### Web Engineering & UI Performance
- **Frameworks**: Next.js (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG), React 19, TypeScript.
- **Styling & Motion**: TailwindCSS, CSS Modules, Framer Motion, GSAP (ScrollTrigger), Three.js / React Three Fiber.
- **Architecture**: Micro-frontends, Web Components, isolated Shadow DOM widgets.

### Specialised Industry Domains
- **HIPAA Compliant Healthtech**: End-to-end encryption for Protected Health Information (PHI), audit logging, WebRTC video consultation pipelines.
- **Computer Vision & Embedded Systems**: OpenCV video frame processing, PyTorch inference servers, edge-device telemetry streaming.
- **Testimonial & Social Proof SaaS**: Automated speech-to-text AI transcription, multi-currency processing (Stripe & Paystack), isolated Shadow DOM script embeds.

## 3. Case Studies & Shipped Enterprise Projects

### Project 1: Wytnest (Founder & Full-Stack Architect)
- **Problem**: Traditional testimonial tools use basic popups that conflict with host website styles and fail to provide readable transcriptions for video reviews.
- **Solution**: Built Wytnest — a video and written testimonial SaaS platform designed with isolated Shadow DOM widgets to prevent visual style contamination on host websites. Integrated AI-powered automatic speech-to-text transcription for video testimonials, giving business owners instant text quotes and searchable transcripts. Implemented dual-currency payment flows supporting USD (Stripe) and NGN (Paystack).
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3, Speech-to-Text AI pipeline.
- **Key Metrics**: 0% CSS leakage on embedded sites, automatic video-to-text transcription in < 5 seconds per minute of video.

### Project 2: Axflo Logistics Engine (Lead Infrastructure Architect)
- **Problem**: Fleet telemetry engines stalled during high-traffic surges, missing vehicle geolocation pings and slowing driver route assignments.
- **Solution**: Architected a distributed Go-based ingestion engine capable of processing 10,000+ geo-pings per second over WebSockets. Integrated Redis Pub/Sub for instant location broadcasting and optimized PostgreSQL spatial indexing (PostGIS).
- **Tech Stack**: Go (Golang), Redis, PostGIS / PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS ECS.
- **Key Metrics**: Latency reduced from 450ms to 18ms, 99.99% uptime during peak dispatch hours.

### Project 3: RecoverDerm Tele-Dermatology (Principal Systems Engineer)
- **Problem**: Healthcare providers needed a secure, US HIPAA-compliant platform for remote dermatology consultations with encrypted medical image storage.
- **Solution**: Engineered a HIPAA-compliant platform with zero-knowledge AES-256 encryption at rest (AWS KMS) and TLS 1.3 in transit. Integrated WebRTC for high-definition video consultations with secure snapshot capture directly into encrypted medical records.
- **Tech Stack**: Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, AWS KMS, WebRTC, React.
- **Key Metrics**: Passed security & HIPAA compliance audit; processed over 15,000 patient consultations smoothly.

### Project 4: Chronos Financial Telemetry (Senior Systems Engineer)
- **Problem**: Algorithmic market monitoring required real-time price updates with strict sub-10ms execution bounds.
- **Solution**: Built a low-latency Go telemetry pipeline leveraging lock-free ring buffers, Redis caching layers, and TimescaleDB time-series storage.
- **Tech Stack**: Go, Redis, TimescaleDB, Docker, AWS.
- **Key Metrics**: Average execution latency of 6.2ms under heavy market volatility.
